name: swarmery-link
description: Mod (function hooks): reports this session's live state (turn start and end, tool calls by name and input hash, context fill, rate limits, cost) to a local swarmery daemon over its token-guarded link API. A sensor only in 0.1: it never blocks, changes or answers anything, and it switches itself off when the daemon's token file is absent.

control.title: Control from the dashboard
control.description: Reserved for a later release (answering approvals and questions from the dashboard). In 0.1 it only logs that it is not implemented; it registers no gating hook.

planBand.title: Plan band
planBand.description: Reserved for a later release (a band above the prompt showing the running plan). In 0.1 it only logs that it is not implemented.

swarm.title: Swarm view
swarm.description: Reserved for a later release (sibling sessions of the same plan). In 0.1 it only logs that it is not implemented.

forecast.title: Forecast
forecast.description: Reserved for a later release (the plan's forecast beside the live figures). In 0.1 it only logs that it is not implemented.

daemonUrl.title: Daemon URL
daemonUrl.description: The daemon's REST origin. Loopback only; the link API refuses a Host that does not name the daemon.
